component: Agent 3 -- Error Explanation Agent (evidence-grounded constrained renderer)
note: single-shot; the evidence pack is the chain of thought. OLLAMA_API_KEY is env-only and never enters evidence/prompt/artifacts.

faithfulness_gate.audit: citation validity; numeric grounding (2% rel tol, ranges split, citation ids stripped); NIH-lexicon class grounding; local band agreement; 200-word cap; coverage advisory
faithfulness_gate.tolerance: 0 -- a rendering failing the audit is replaced by the deterministic template + red note

privacy.gt: include_gt=True only in offline batch; app passes include_gt=False
privacy.pixels: never leave the machine -- LLM sees computed metrics only

band_calibration.rule: fixed quintiles p20/p40/p60/p80 per metric per view; clip_lo+clip_hi>0.10 -> 'high clipping'; missing table -> 'unavailable'
